Meshy models come out watertight and manifold. A built-in printability check still scans every export and auto-repairs any edge cases before you slice. [图标] [图标] Auto Split Print in Multi-Color, or Split to Fit Multi-color printing maps each texture to the right filament, with clean color boundaries. When a model is too complex, Auto Split breaks it into watertight parts, pre-arranged on the build plate. Straight to Your Slicer Export as STL, OBJ, or 3MF, then send models directly to OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio, and more, ready for single- or multi-color printing.
